title: Quote Window for Deductible Decreases on Loan Transactions — NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own)
content:
### NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own) — quote window for a deductible decrease recorded for a loan transaction

The quote window of a pending deductible decrease recorded for a loan transaction, on a tier that carries no ICC coverage, is measured from the request date to the receipt date (the later of the request date and the date of the latest premium payment on the policy received on or after the request date).

| Request and premium | Quote window |
|---|---|
| The request records a loan closing date and the premium was received no later than that date | 60 days |
| The request records a loan closing date and the premium came after it | 30 days |
| Otherwise | No days |

When the receipt date falls outside the window, the change may take effect no earlier than 30 days after the receipt date.

*Points of judgement.*
- A receipt date 60 days after the request date, with the premium received by the closing date, is inside the window; 61 days is outside.
- Where the premium came after the closing date the window is 30 days: a receipt date 30 days after the request date is inside, 31 days is outside.
- Where the window is no days, the receipt date falls within it only when it is the request date itself.
